name: git-read
why: read-only git commands work inside the sandbox
script:
git rev-parse --show-toplevel || fail "rev-parse"
git status --short >/dev/null || fail "status"
git log --oneline -1 || fail "log"
git diff --stat HEAD >/dev/null || fail "diff"
git show --stat HEAD >/dev/null || fail "show"
test -n "$(git ls-files | head -n 1)" || fail "ls-files"
git grep -q -e . -- README.md || fail "grep"
git blame -L 1,1 -- README.md >/dev/null || fail "blame"

name: workspace-write
script:
echo allowed > autodev-probe-allowed.txt || fail "write"
grep -qx allowed autodev-probe-allowed.txt || fail "read back"

name: maven-test
why: the task's fast test command runs (Maven, no Docker)

name: git-dir-writes-blocked
why: the git directory cannot be changed, directly or through git
script:
d="$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)" || fail "no git dir"
blocked "create a file in the git dir" touch "$d/autodev-probe-planted"
blocked "append to the git config" sh -c "echo '[core]' >> '$d/config'"
blocked "create config.lock" sh -c ": > '$d/config.lock'"
blocked "plant a hook" sh -c "mkdir -p '$d/hooks' && echo x > '$d/hooks/autodev-probe-planted'"
blocked "plant info/attributes" sh -c "echo '* filter=x' > '$d/info/attributes'"
blocked "git config" git config user.name autodev-probe
blocked "git commit" git -c user.name=p -c user.email=p@p.invalid commit --allow-empty -q -m probe
blocked "git update-ref" git update-ref refs/heads/autodev-probe HEAD
blocked "git add (index write)" git add -A
blocked "rewrite .git" sh -c 'printf "gitdir: /tmp\n" > .git'
blocked "rename .git" mv .git .git-autodev-probe-planted
blocked "remove .git" rm -rf .git
blocked "remove the git dir" rm -rf "$d"
git rev-parse HEAD >/dev/null || fail "git no longer works after the attempts"

name: github-writes-blocked
script:
blocked "create a file in .github" touch .github/autodev-probe-planted
blocked "edit a workflow" sh -c 'echo "#" >> .github/workflows/ci.yml'
blocked "edit a helper" sh -c 'echo "#" >> .github/autodev/gate.py'
blocked "remove .github" rm -rf .github

name: home-writes-blocked
why: shell, git and ssh configuration in the home directory cannot be changed
script:
blocked "append to ~/.bashrc" sh -c 'echo "# probe" >> ~/.bashrc'
blocked "write ~/.gitconfig" sh -c 'echo "[x]" >> ~/.gitconfig'
blocked "plant in ~/.ssh" sh -c 'mkdir -p ~/.ssh && : > ~/.ssh/autodev-probe-planted'
blocked "plant in ~/.config/git" sh -c 'mkdir -p ~/.config/git && : > ~/.config/git/autodev-probe-planted'

name: credentials-hidden
why: no token reaches sandboxed commands, including through /proc
script:
for v in CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN GITHUB_TOKEN ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; do
  [ -z "${!v:-}" ] || fail "$v is visible"
done
env | grep -q autodev-fake-secret && fail "a token value is in the environment"
for f in /proc/[0-9]*/environ /proc/[0-9]*/cmdline; do
  grep -qs autodev-fake-secret "$f" && fail "a token value is readable in $f"
done
echo "no token visible"

name: network-restricted
why: only the package registries are reachable
script:
python3 - <<'PY' || fail "network"
import sys, urllib.request
bad = []
for url in ("https://api.github.com/zen", "https://example.com/", "https://api.anthropic.com/"):
    try:
        urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=10)
        bad.append(url)
    except Exception as exc:
        print("blocked", url, type(exc).__name__)
try:
    urllib.request.urlopen("https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/", timeout=20)
    print("allowed https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/")
except Exception as exc:
    print("allowlisted registry unreachable:", type(exc).__name__, exc)
    bad.append("maven")
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
PY
